'''Victoria F. Samanidou''' is a Greek [[analytical chemistry|analytical chemist]]. She is a professor at [[Aristotle University of Thessaloniki]] in [[Thessaloniki]], Greece.

== Achievements and honours ==
{{Expand-section|date=October 2021}}
